record.title: Melilla commercial customs closure
record.direction: Documented reopening shipment Melilla to Morocco
record.movement: Commercial consignments; not a claim of general passenger closure
record.enforcement: Formal closure or reported non-operation; permeability not systematically measured
record.status_observation: Historical episode; status at 2026-10-21 not inferred
record.official_rationale: Moroccan government spokesperson Mustafa Jalfi stated on August 30, 2018 that the customs closure was intended to develop commercial activity at Nador/Beni Enzar port.
record.context: January 2023 trial interrupted commercial customs nonoperation; January 2025 was a subsequent limited operational restoration, not first passage.
record.uncertainty: Named Moroccan spokesperson provides a stated commercial-port-development rationale; it does not establish every motive. Closely matching August 30 press reports share a reporting lineage and describe closure since July 31, whereas the retained onset is August 1 from other evidence. January 27, 2023 trial passage does not prove unrestricted restoration.
